identity_core.name: Kitsune Porcelain Mask
identity_core.origin: Japanese Noh theater - fox spirit archetype, adapted to engineered ceramic
identity_core.function: Ceremonial/decorative wall-mount mask representing the kitsune (fox) spirit
identity_core.one_sentence: A viewer sees this and immediately knows it is a white ceramic Japanese fox mask with precise manufactured form.

objects.readable_as: a symmetrical Japanese kitsune porcelain mask - white ceramic, fox-shaped, clearly a manufactured artifact

silhouette_rules.must_read_as: a mask face-shape with pointed fox ears at top and a tapered snout at center
key_contour_features: concave interior implied by shadow at eye slits
forbidden_silhouettes: flat plane without depth (loses object quality)

must_have_parts.description: Two pointed ear forms at top of mask, clearly part of the mask structure
Narrow elongated eye openings, dark/void, angled slightly upward
Raised nose/snout ridge running vertically down center
Defined cheek surfaces with subtle curvature
Visible edge thickness where mask meets air - proves it is a 3D object, not a flat image
Subtle carved line or slight opening suggesting mouth

material_truth.secondary_material: crimson kintsugi accent seam (gold-repaired crack motif)
material_truth.texture_descriptor: dry dense eggshell microtexture, visible sparse fine hairline fractures, non-reflective matte ceramic finish

common_misreads.cause: AI generates a person instead of the mask object alone
prompt emphasis on ceramic/texture overwhelms object identity
missing depth cues, rim thickness, shadow
AI interprets 'kitsune' as literal fox rather than mask
fox-specific features (ears, snout) lost to smoothing
AI defaults to shiny ceramic instead of matte engineered surface

anti_misread_rules.rule: Must be a single isolated object, not worn on a face
No human skin, eyes, or organic facial features
No fur, hair, or animal skin texture
Matte finish only - no gloss, no specular, no reflection
Fox ears must be structurally present at mask crown
Eye slits must be dark voids, not painted-on eyes
Visible rim/edge thickness to prove 3D manufactured object
Subject must occupy clear central frame, not cropped or ambient

sanitation.identity_key: mask::kitsune porcelain mask::a symmetrical japanese kitsune porcelain mask - white ceramic, fox-shaped, clearly a manufactured artifact
